Schlumberger Drilling and Measurements | STATOIL VOLVE: 15/9-F-9 | • | 4.0 | Observations and Recommendations | Observations and Recommendations | 36” - Section - MWD: | MWD Run #1: Observations | • | The BHA included a 9” Telescope MWD tool with continuous D&I, stationary | surveys, shocks, gamma ray, jamming measurements. | • | The Telescope was programmed at 12 Hz frequency, QPSK at 6 bps. Very good | signal during the entire run: average SPT signal 1.45 bars, signal confidence 90%. | Demodulating with multi-equalizer, SPT1&2_R00, band pass [9.75 Hz, 14.25Hz]. | • | The Services provided was RT Inclination and RT Uncorrected Gamma Ray. There | was no memory data from the tool. The maximum inclination that was allowed for | this section was 0.5. Surveys were taken at every 10m and the final inclination at | TD was 0.44 deg.  Mud type used for this section was seawater with a mud weight | of 1.05g/cm3. | • | Before running in hole the hookload sensor was installed and the surface syst

Schlumberger Drilling and Measurements | STATOIL VOLVE: 15/9-F-9 | • | 17 ½” - Section - MWD: | MWD Run #2: Observations | • | The BHA was RIH , the plugs, collar cement and shoe drilled without any | problem. Rotary drilling commenced from 226m to the KOP at 530m, using | 4430 lpm to wash the formation and maintain verticality. At the connection at | 272m, a good gMWD survey was made at the conductor shoe and it was | decided there was no need to run the single shot survey of the conductor. The | ROP was fast through this section averaging > 60 m/hr for the most part ( max > | 90m/hr and result of the use of the Mill tooth bit in the soft formation.. | • | At the connection at 515m the KOP was commenced early to turn the well | azimuth toward desired at 90degrees. We turned the well path past the plan | towards 101° in order reduce the anti collision with F-14. Average slides of 15 - | 20m were needed to achieve the well path and the max DLS was 2.23°. ROP | was generally high over 60

Schlumberger Drilling and Measurements | STATOIL VOLVE: 15/9-F-9 | • | PowerPulse gave continuous D&I, stationary surveys, shocks and vibrations, and | downhole D&I temperature measurements. | • | The ARC tool with APWD gave Phase Shift and Attenuation Resistivity | measurement, | Gamma | Ray, | Annulus | Temperature, | Annulus | Pressure | measurements. | • | A toolbox meeting was performed prior to picking up BHA for safe handling of the | BHA in general, especially picking up of the ILS. | • | RIH to a depth of 883 mMD, tag the top of cement then drills into the formation | from 918 mMD. Displaced seawater to WBM 1.27 sg.  Drill ahead into the | reservoir at 1073 mMD, when Gamma Ray went up to 100 GAPI, TD was called by | Drilling Supervisor at 1083 mMD. Signal is good through the run, we were drilling | at ROP around 40 MPH, hold the inclination between 9 and 10 degrees.
